name: Banh canh
summary: Bánh canh in Hoi An is a thick-noodle soup in two flours, rice or bột lọc. It is not the Da Nang snakehead bowl.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, calls it a familiar local bowl.
howToEat: The article names toppings of roasted pork, fish cake, herbs, and seafood, and says to add green chili, chili sauce, and garlic-chili fish sauce.
Ask which noodle the pot is using. Rice flour and bột lọc are both printed.
where: Hoi An. A street and the hour are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh canh — thick noodles in Hoi An
